_about: What can be installed. The installer shows one checkbox per component, grouped; manage.py installs a component's launchd agents, Python extras (pyproject.toml), models (models.lock.json) and setup steps. requires lists components that are added with it.

components.title: atlas, the hotkey assistant
components.summary: Press Ctrl+Option+Space and type: open apps and folders, find files by name or by what's in them, list and read files, run a shell command, install from Homebrew, battery and memory helpers, power saving, keyboard lock, do not disturb. The email agents' dashboards open here too.

components.title: Clipboard tidy
components.summary: Dedents copied code, and turns a copied URL into a Markdown link without tracking parameters.

components.title: Copy text from the screen
components.summary: Cmd+Shift+2: select a region and copy its text, read by Apple's on-device text recognition. Tables paste as columns and code keeps its indentation.

components.title: Screenshots to the clipboard
components.summary: Copies each new screenshot (Cmd+Shift+3/4/5) to the clipboard as an image.

components.title: Long command alerts
components.summary: Shows an alert when a terminal command that ran for over 15 seconds finishes.

components.title: Unpack downloads
components.summary: Unpacks archives that land in Downloads into a folder and moves the archive to the Trash.

components.title: Audio guard
components.summary: Pauses and mutes when headphones drop to the speakers or the Mac sleeps, and switches to a display's speakers when one is connected.

components.title: Popup inbox
components.summary: Shows messages that your own scripts drop into the inbox folder as banners that stay until clicked.

components.title: Desktop and Downloads archiver
components.summary: Every night: moves Desktop screenshots to ~/Archive/Screenshots and items untouched for 14 days to ~/Archive/YYYY-MM, and trashes old installers and partial downloads.

components.title: Developer cache cleaner
components.summary: Sundays at 02:00: removes Python caches, and node_modules and target folders of projects untouched for 30 days.

components.title: Log trimmer
components.summary: Saturdays at 01:00: deletes crash reports older than 7 days and empties logs over 50 MB.

components.title: Package cache cleaner
components.summary: On the 1st of each month: cleans the Homebrew, pip, npm, pnpm, yarn and uv caches.

components.title: App blocker
components.summary: Quits Music, TV, Podcasts, Tips, Freeform and Image Playground the moment they open, and answers the Play key itself so macOS stops launching Music.

components.title: Adult-site blocker
components.summary: Quits the browser when its active tab is on the OISD NSFW blocklist. Two agents restart each other so it can't be switched off on a whim; remove it here.

components.title: Gmail connection
components.summary: Signs in to one Gmail account and checks it every 5 minutes for the email agents. Needs an OAuth client from your own Google Cloud project; setup walks you through it.

components.title: Inbox unsubscriber
components.summary: Works out which senders you don't want from what you do with their mail and, with your approval, unsubscribes or blocks them. A report every Sunday.

components.title: Data broker removal
components.summary: Asks data brokers to delete what they hold on you and follows each request until the listing is gone. Nothing is sent until you enter your details and approve.

components.title: Where does my email go (Edge extension)
components.summary: An Edge extension that shows, under every field, who gets what you type, blocks what can be blocked, and tests risky fields with a throwaway address.

components.title: Pock keeper
components.summary: Relaunches Pock, the Touch Bar app, if it dies. Only useful with Pock installed.
